Now… what can I get you? Our coffee is…

…!?
That ring!? Destron's…Uwah!
What are you… Ughhh…

Oyassan…

Oyassan…

That's strange? There's no way nobody's here… Oyass…
Hello, Amigo…
That voice!? Doktor G!

Heh heh heh… Listen, Shiro Kazami! I have Tobei Tachibana!

Come to Shinobazu Pond at four o'clock this afternoon! Understood?
All right, understood… I'll be there!

Shiro Kazami, I've been waiting for you!

The traitor Joji Yuki… you're with him too?

Heh heh heh… I will defeat you both, without fail! Here I come!

Shiro Kazami, I've been waiting for you!

Heh heh heh… I will defeat you, without fail! Here I come!

Oh, I'm saved!

Thank you… Taki, [HERO4]!
Kazami… We're fine over here! We've rescued Mr. Tachibana.
Thanks, [HERO2]! Taki, take care of Oyassan.
Thanks, [HERO2]! Taki, take care of Oyassan.
Yuki… We're fine over here! We've rescued Mr. Tachibana.

Kazamiii… We're fine over here! We rescued Mr. Tachibana…
Thanks, [HERO2]! Taki, take care of Oyassan.

Thanks, [HERO2]! Taki, take care of Oyassan.
Thanks, [HERO2]! Taki, take care of Oyassan.
Nngh… Curse you, you impudent pests! Come forth, Gigant!

All right, leave it to me!

Come on… let's go, Oyassan!
Riiider V3… Take a good look at my true form!

…!?

Doktor G's true form is… Crab Laser!

…!?

Doktor G's true form is… Crab Laser!
Riiiderman… Take a good look at my true form!

…!?

Doktor G's true form is… Crab Laser!

…!?

Doktor G's true form is… Crab Laser!

Heh heh heh… Take a good look at my true form!

My true identity is Crab Laser!
So you were still alive!? How did you escape that explosion?
Heh heh heh… Never mind that, worry about yourselves!
The four great executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker! We'll beat you as many times as it takes!
Heh heh heh… Will it really be that easy?
We blew up Destron's cyborg factory with our own hands! You can't be revived anymore!
We blew up Destron's cyborg factory with our own hands! You can't be revived anymore!
We blew up Destron's cyborg factory with our own hands! You can't be revived anymore!
We blew up Destron's cyborg factory with our own hands! You can't be revived anymore!
We blew up Destron's cyborg factory with our own hands! You can't be revived anymore!
There's no need for that! Because… you're the ones who are going to die.
Shocker, Gel-Shocker! This time it really is the end!
The true might of our Gel-Shocker… we'll make you feel it!

Riiider V3… I will gracefully admit defeat in this fight.

But… great Destron will never perish… Farewell… Kamen Riiider V3!

Riiiders… I will gracefully admit defeat in this fight.

But… great Destron will never perish… Farewell… Kamen Riiiders!
Glory to our Shocker!
Ngh… Beaten… yet again!
Nuoh… Is this the end!? Long live Shocker!
Glory to our Gel-Shocker!
Shadow Moon!
Black Sun! I'll settle this here and now!
Here I come!
Wait, both of you!
…!? Creation King!
At last, the time has come to reveal my true form to you!
So this is the Creation King's true form!

Heh heh heh… Fuhahahahaha!

The Creation King of our Gorgom is replaced every fifty thousand years, growing in power each time…

And now, as a new fifty thousand years begins, once the next Creation King is born, he will gain the power to rule not just the Earth, but the entire universe!
The entire universe!?
That's insane!?

Once we rule the universe, humanity will no longer be needed!

We will wipe out every last human, and then… build an empire ruled by monsters!
Stop it!

Heh heh heh… Give up, Black Sun! This has already been decided!

Listen… this is your last chance!

Abandon humanity, return to our Gorgom, fight Shadow Moon, and one of you shall become the Creation King!
Don't mess with me! I will protect humanity no matter what!

It cannot be helped…

Shadow Moon! I have only a few hours left until my life ends… Defeat Black Sun before then!

I shall share my power with you! Crush Black Sun underfoot like an insect!

Beat him down completely and take the King Stone!

Nobuhiko, do you really not have a human heart anymore? Do you truly mean to destroy this beautiful Earth?

This Earth is alive… People, animals, insects, they all love peace and live! Do you really think it doesn't matter what happens to them?
Fuhahahahaha… You're naive, Black Sun! Look!

The Creation King's power already dwells within my body!

I'll crush you easily and take the entire universe! Fuhahahahahaha…
Heh heh heh… Hahahahaha…
Shadow Moon! You bastaaard!

I no longer think of you as Nobuhiko!

To protect this beautiful Earth, I will defeat you!
Here I come!
Not yet! I can't afford to lose!
Not yet! I can't afford to lose!

You just won't give up, will you!

Very well… I'll settle this in a way that suits you! Shadow Flash!
Battle Hopper!
Battle Hopper!
Battle Hopper!

uncertain: U11781-U11783: Tobei's line to a customer continues over narration-kind rows until he is attacked.
U11785-U11786: Shiro answering the phone; continuation row narration-kind.
U11793-U11804: honorific variants (-san/-kun) collapse to the same English; Yuki's 滝君 also "Taki".
U11807/U11810/U11826/U11827: Crab Laser's drawn-out ラ～イダ / ラーイダー rendered "Riiider".
U11816: 四大幹部 = the four revived executives in their monster forms (Golden Wolf, Ika-Devil, Garagaranda, Hiru-Chameleon).
U11815: 事じる read as 案じる "worry about".
U11840/U11843: 辿え read as 迎え, 薬く read as 築く.
U11857: 住生際 read as 往生際; シャドーフラッシュ rendered with the glossary spelling "Shadow Flash".
U11858: Shadow Moon calling Battle Hopper (it was Black Sun's bike) - kept as written.
